properties.name: BL-129: `medium` is settable through `set_interface_spec`. The property and its honest `unspecified` default already existed and the foundation exemption already worked — only the door was missing, so a user following add_interface then set_interface_spec left every boundary unspecified and collected false single-point-of-failure warnings for shared libraries, having done exactly what the tools invited. Put on set_interface_spec rather than add_interface because it is part of what a consumer must AGREE with, which is that tool's subject, and the seam checker already compares it.
